content: Bagula ꞌana toguinuwao onasemalimalidi
“Yaubada ꞌina loina ꞌatuwa tai ꞌebweuna ma ina bagula. Tai nina gonamapumapuya
ꞌitoolo ga ꞌitauya ꞌasaya ga ꞌaina toguinuwao ꞌibwauyedima sabi paisewa ꞌina bagulaya.
ꞌEnega loina ꞌisaꞌuna be ꞌaene ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna paisewa ꞌana maisa kina ꞌebweuna, ga sitagwala. ꞌEnega ꞌietunediya ga sitauya ꞌina bagulaya sabi paisewa.
“Ga sinala ꞌisaetuꞌema ga tai nina ꞌitauya limana ꞌasa nina ꞌena, ga tomota ꞌaidi wate ꞌilobedi simiyamiya daidaita.
ꞌEnega ꞌibwauyedima ga ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌOmi wate watauya ꞌigu bagulaya be wapaisewa, be ꞌimi paisewa ꞌana maisa palupaluna yada ꞌebwaꞌemi.’ ꞌEnega sitauya bagulaya.
“ꞌEnega ꞌasuoleoleya ta ꞌasuinuwanuwaya wate ꞌitauya limana ꞌasa nina ꞌena, ga nada tomota ꞌaidi ꞌilobedi ga ꞌibwauyedi ga wate ꞌietunedi ga sitauya ꞌina bagulaya.
“Ta ꞌasuinuwanuwa ꞌaiꞌailaya wate ꞌiapwesa limana ga ꞌitauya ꞌasaya ga tomota wate ꞌaidi ꞌilobedi ga ꞌienaidedi, ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌase manuna ꞌasiyata maiboꞌana wamiyamiya daidaita?’
“Ta sigwae, ‘Manuna nigeya ꞌebweu yaita ꞌibwaubwauyema sabi paisewa.’ Ga tai nina ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌOmi wate watauya ꞌigu bagulaya be wapaisewa.’

“ꞌEnega boiꞌunu ꞌenaya toni bagula nina ꞌina paisewa ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, ‘Toguinuwao maiboꞌadi ꞌubwauyedima be ꞌadi maisa ꞌuꞌebwaꞌedi, taudi tomai auwau ꞌediyega ꞌueꞌale be ꞌadi maisa ꞌuꞌebwaꞌedi be ꞌana laba taudi ꞌasiyata maiboꞌana ꞌena sipaisewaya ꞌadi maisa ꞌebe losalowa ꞌenaya ꞌuꞌebwaꞌedi.’
ꞌEnega taudi ꞌasuinuwanuwa namo ꞌenaya sipaisewaya simai ga ꞌadi maisa kina ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna siꞌewa.

Muliyega maiboꞌadi wate topaisewa nidi simai ga ꞌadi maisa kina ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna siꞌewena. Ta togimi paisewa wate, taudi ꞌasiyata maiboꞌana ꞌena sipaisewaya simai ga sinuwena ꞌaene ꞌiabe maisa ma ꞌana loeposeyana siꞌeꞌewa, ta nigeya, taudi wate kina ꞌebweuna namo siꞌewena.
ꞌEnega ꞌidi kina siꞌewedi ta tonibagula ꞌena silomugi,
ga sigwae, ‘Tomota tomai auwau ꞌidi paisewa tuta kukupana namo, ta ꞌaboꞌama ꞌasiyata maiboꞌana ala solanaya ꞌapaisewa, ta ꞌana maisa ꞌatuwa maiboꞌama ꞌima paisewa leleleya.’
“Ta ꞌInapwana ꞌebweuna ꞌediyega ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, ‘Gosiyagu, nigeya wate yaloina gesi ꞌemuya, manuna ꞌida gimiloina ꞌaene kina ꞌebweuna namo ꞌuꞌewa.
ꞌImu kina gete ꞌuꞌewa be ꞌutatauya. Ta ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu loina ꞌaene tomota tomai auwau ꞌadi maisa yaꞌebwaꞌedi ꞌoyo nadigega ꞌamu maisa.
Maisa gete ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu ꞌebeloina. Geyaꞌabo ꞌomi waloiloina. Geyaꞌabo ꞌigu oboboma tomota ꞌediya manuna waeꞌipiꞌipi.’
ꞌEnega taudi simulimuliya maꞌetamo sida nugana ta taudi sinuganugana maꞌetamo simuliya.”
Yesu ꞌina mwawasa ꞌetamo manuna ꞌionaupaupa limana
ꞌEtamo Yesu Yelusalema manuna ꞌituꞌetuꞌe ga ꞌina tononoyao site tuwelo ꞌiꞌauꞌewedi ꞌeda tupitupinaya ga taudimo, ta ꞌieonedi,
ꞌigwae, “Gete tuga tatuꞌetuꞌe Yelusalema. ꞌAboꞌagu Tomota Natuna ta ꞌagu tosipupu nina ꞌida telesipupuyegu totaliyao sinabwadi be loina ꞌana toeꞌitao ꞌediya be ꞌigu mwawasa manuna sida loina,
be muliyega sida ꞌebwayaegu taudi nigeya me Yudia ꞌediya be sida tuyeyegu be balaeyega sisapigu, be kelose ꞌenaya situtu epaꞌiyegu, be ꞌasiyata ꞌetonina ꞌenaya Yaubada ꞌida gietoolo limagu.”
Yemesa be Yoni sinadiya ꞌina sida Yesu ꞌena
Muliyega Sebedi mwanena manatunao simai ga sinadina Yesu ꞌenaya ꞌiꞌaetulasaya ta ꞌisida ꞌenaya.

Ga Yesu ꞌigwae, “Toꞌase nuwanuwayo?” Ta waine nina ꞌigwae, “Nuwanuwagu be natugwao ꞌediya ꞌuda tagwala be ꞌabo tuta nina ꞌuetoloina, sawesawenaya be selabemuya sida miyatowa, ꞌebweuna ꞌataimuya ta ꞌebweuna gegeumimuya.”

ꞌEnega Yesu tai nidi ꞌieonedi, “ꞌOmi ꞌimi sida gete ꞌana mwalatoi nigeya wamwalamwalatoni. Mwaꞌadega, ꞌelouya keigana ꞌenega yanunuma kapekapeyana be ꞌomi wate ꞌenega wanunuma?” Ta sigwae, “Sawesawemaya.”

Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila, keiga nina ꞌenega yanunuma ꞌomi wate ꞌenega wanunuma, ta esi nigeya sawesaweguya be yaesinuwa yaisigedi maꞌetamo ꞌigu etoloina ꞌenaya ꞌataiguya be gegeumiguya sida miyatowa, manuna gete Tamagu tauna saꞌi ꞌina ꞌebeloina be ꞌiesinuwa.”
Ta tononoyao site sanau Yemesa be Yoni ꞌidi sida sinonona ga sigamwasowaledi.
ꞌEnega Yesu maiboꞌadi ꞌibwau egogonedima ga ꞌieonedi, “ꞌOmi wamwalatonina ꞌaene ꞌinapwanao baleꞌuya ꞌidi tomotaiyao siloiloina paꞌaledi,
ta ꞌomi geyaꞌabo wate nadigega taudi waguiguinuwaꞌesa. Ta ꞌeguma yaita ꞌoyo nuwanuwayo be ꞌemiyega ꞌuetoloina ꞌilobweneyo be gosemwao manudi ꞌuda etoguinuwa.
“Ta wate ꞌeguma yaita ꞌoyo nuwanuwayo be ꞌemiyega ꞌuetoanugana ꞌilobweneyo be gosemwao manudi ꞌuda etopaisewa.

Wate nadigega ꞌaboꞌagu Tomota Natuna yamai baleꞌuya nigeya ꞌaene tomota manugu siguinuwa, ta esi sabi guinuwa tomota manudi, ta wate yatagwalegu be yamwamwawasa tomota maiboꞌami ꞌami etoliꞌama manuna.”
Tomatakebo siteluwa Yesu ꞌigieboboꞌanedi
ꞌEnega Yeliko sipilisinena ta boda sinabwana Yesu simuliyena.
Ta tomata kebokebo siteluwa ꞌeda tupitupinaya simiyatowaya Yesu ꞌina sakowasi alena sinonona, ꞌenega Yesu ꞌena sibwau, “Debida tubuna ye, ꞌuda ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyema.”
Ta pwalu siteluwa nidi ꞌenadi sinonona ga siꞌetobodedi, sigwae, “Walosaꞌu! Tuwa bwau!” Ta ꞌenega siteluwa nidi sibwau toitoila, sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, Debida tubuna ye, ꞌuda ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyema.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌitoolo ga ꞌibwauyedima ta ꞌigwae, “Toꞌase nuwanuwami be manumi yada guinuwe?”
Ta sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, kapekapeyana be matama ꞌuda gieꞌesasedi?”
Ta Yesu ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌeleyedi ga matadi ꞌigitoodi, ga siꞌesasedi, ta ꞌenega Yesu wate simuliyena.
